seed: On a video in Edit the right hand panel runs up beside the title bar's Ask, View | Edit and panel toggle. Nothing in the panel may be drawn under them, at rest or scrolled: rows scrolled up stop at the title bar's lower edge and fade there, the way content passes under a Mac toolbar. Before 2026-11-09 a scrolled panel slid its rows straight under Ask (a header read through it, the Transitions search field you could see and not click). At Next defaults, no flag set: a cut picked, its Transitions search field CLICKED by a real press and typed in, then the panel scrolled a little and a lot, measured each time with expectTitleBarClear.

steps.note: a cut picked: the panel holds Transitions open with its search field, every row under the title bar's strip
the search field took a real click and the typing: only the dips are left
scrolled a little: the top row fades out at the title bar's lower edge, never under Ask
scrolled a lot: nothing of the panel above its top edge
